resolutions.phrase: Grafting moves from late March, as the 1 October call set it, to the second half of February.

referents.why: Replaces the late-March grafting window ("the orchard grafting happens in late March, once the frosts are done") with the second half of February.
The 1 October planning call document is named only as the origin of the earlier setting; it anchors the reference without being engaged.

resolutions.why: The only grafting-timing node in the graph is the late-March statement from the 1 October call, which the segment explicitly names and replaces. It sits in one position, so the binding converges on a single set.
